label: For "Coverage Hole Detection from Crowd Measurements": Find locations with weak or absent coverage from anonymised device measurements and drive-test data, so planning targets the areas that users actually struggle in. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Treating sample counts as demand.
